newsHighlights.title: Pair of Chinese giant pandas arrives in US city Atlanta
newsHighlights.summary: A chartered cargo plane carrying two giant pandas, Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, landed in Atlanta on Sunday morning, drawing warm attention from the US public.
newsHighlights.translation: 一架包租货运飞机载着“平平”和“福双”两只大熊猫于周日上午抵达美国亚特兰大，受到美国民众的热烈关注。

newsHighlights.title: Xi's letter for GDI anniversary dialogue draws global acclaim
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping's letter for the Global Development Initiative anniversary dialogue won wide praise for reaffirming a commitment to green and sustainable development.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席致全球发展倡议周年对话的贺信重申了对绿色可持续发展的承诺，赢得国际社会广泛赞誉。

newsHighlights.title: Understanding China in the new era: From vision to action
newsHighlights.summary: Following the Global Development Initiative, the Global Security Initiative and the Global Civilization Initiative, President Xi proposed the Global Governance Initiative, forming four interconnected proposals.
newsHighlights.translation: 继全球发展倡议、全球安全倡议、全球文明倡议之后，习近平主席提出全球治理倡议，四大倡议相互贯通。

newsHighlights.title: China, US reach consensus on eight outcomes in Xi's visit
newsHighlights.summary: China and the United States reached consensus on eight outcomes during President Xi's state visit, including cooperation on climate change and green development.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席访美期间，中美双方就八项成果达成共识，其中包括应对气候变化与绿色发展合作。

newsHighlights.title: International experts hail outcomes of the visit
newsHighlights.summary: International experts praised the outcomes of the state visit, saying that stability in China-US ties breeds prosperity for the world.
newsHighlights.translation: 国际专家称赞此访成果，并表示中美关系稳定为世界带来繁荣。

quote.quote: The greatest threat to our planet is the belief that someone else will save it.
quote.author: Robert Swan
quote.translation: 对地球最大的威胁，是相信会有别人来拯救它。
quote.explanation: 这句名言提醒我们，环境保护没有旁观者。无论是大熊猫栖息地的保护，还是全球可持续发展目标的实现，都需要每一个人主动承担责任，而不是等待他人行动。

vocabulary.definition: （对自然环境、动植物等的）保护；保存
vocabulary.example: International conservation programs have helped giant panda populations gradually recover in the wild.
vocabulary.translation: 国际保护项目帮助大熊猫野外种群逐步恢复。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自大熊猫抵达亚特兰大新闻，文中强调对大熊猫及栖息地的长期保护合作。

vocabulary.example: Giant pandas were once among the world's most endangered species.
vocabulary.translation: 大熊猫曾是世界上最濒危的物种之一。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自大熊猫新闻，说明大熊猫的濒危地位及保护成效。

vocabulary.example: Protecting bamboo forests is essential to preserving the natural habitat of giant pandas.
vocabulary.translation: 保护竹林对维护大熊猫的自然栖息地至关重要。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自大熊猫新闻，指大熊猫赖以生存的竹林与山地栖息环境。

vocabulary.definition: 可持续的；能长期保持的
vocabulary.example: The Global Development Initiative calls for people-centered and sustainable growth worldwide.
vocabulary.translation: 全球发展倡议呼吁全球实现以人为本的可持续增长。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自全球发展倡议（GDI）周年对话新闻，可持续发展是该倡议的核心理念。

vocabulary.example: President Xi proposed the Global Governance Initiative last year.
vocabulary.translation: 习近平主席于去年提出全球治理倡议。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自《理解新时代的中国》新闻，文中列举四大全球倡议。

vocabulary.example: The pandas serve as ambassadors of friendship and a shared commitment to biodiversity.
vocabulary.translation: 大熊猫是友谊的使者，也象征着对生物多样性的共同承诺。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自大熊猫抵达亚特兰大新闻，指国际社会对生物多样性保护的共同责任。

vocabulary.definition: 包租的（车辆、飞机、船只等）
vocabulary.example: A chartered FedEx cargo plane carrying two giant pandas landed in Atlanta on Sunday morning.
vocabulary.translation: 一架载有两只大熊猫的联邦快递包租货运飞机于周日上午抵达亚特兰大。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自大熊猫抵达亚特兰大新闻，指运送大熊猫的包机。

vocabulary.example: China and the United States reached consensus on eight outcomes during the state visit.
vocabulary.translation: 中美在国事访问期间就八项成果达成共识。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自中美达成八项成果的新闻，其中包含气候变化与绿色发展合作。

vocabulary.example: Economists say that stability in China-US ties breeds prosperity for the whole world.
vocabulary.translation: 经济学家表示，中美关系稳定为全世界带来繁荣。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自经济学家评论中美关系的新闻，强调稳定促进共同发展。

vocabulary.example: The president's letter reaffirmed China's commitment to green and sustainable development.
vocabulary.translation: 主席的贺信重申了中国对绿色可持续发展的承诺。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自全球发展倡议（GDI）周年对话新闻，指各国对落实可持续发展目标的承诺。

pattern.pattern: Following A, B did C...（在A之后，B做了C……）
pattern.example: Following the Global Development Initiative, the Global Security Initiative and the Global Civilization Initiative, President Xi Jinping proposed the Global Governance Initiative last year.
pattern.translation: 继全球发展倡议、全球安全倡议、全球文明倡议之后，习近平主席于去年提出全球治理倡议。
pattern.usage: 该句型用介词 Following 引出先行的事物或事件，再用主句说明其后发生的动作，逻辑清晰、节奏感强，常用于新闻报道和议论文中表示时间或逻辑上的先后顺序。也可替换为 After A, B did C 或 Building on A, B did C。

grammar.title: 现在分词短语作后置定语与伴随状语
grammar.explanation: 现在分词（V-ing）短语常放在名词后作定语，或放在句中作伴随状语，表示与主句动作同时发生的情况，使句子简洁流畅。判断依据：被修饰的名词与分词之间是主动关系（即名词发出该动作）。注意避免悬垂分词，分词的逻辑主语必须与主句主语一致。
examples: A chartered FedEx cargo plane carrying a pair of Chinese giant pandas landed in Atlanta on Sunday morning.
The two giant pandas arrived in the city, drawing warm attention from local residents and conservationists.

pronunciation.tips: 重音在第二个音节 /ˈsteɪ/ 上，首音节弱读为 /sə/（中央元音 schwa），不要读成 /suːˈsteɪnəbl/。结尾的 -able 要轻快带过，读作 /əbl/，不要读成 /eɪbl/。可按音节慢读三遍：sə-STAY-nə-bəl，再连读加速。
examples: We need sustainable solutions to protect the natural habitat of endangered species.
The Global Development Initiative calls for sustainable and people-centered growth.

reading.title: Giant Pandas Arrive in Atlanta, Highlighting Conservation Cooperation
reading.content: A pair of Chinese giant pandas, Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, arrived in Atlanta, the United States, on Sunday morning, aboard a chartered cargo plane. Their arrival drew eager attention from local residents and conservationists alike. Giant pandas were once among the world's most endangered species, and their survival depends on sustained efforts to protect bamboo forests and natural habitats. Over the past decades, international breeding and research programs have helped panda populations gradually recover in the wild. Experts say the pandas also serve as ambassadors of friendship and a shared commitment to biodiversity. During President Xi Jinping's recent state visit to the United States, the two sides reached consensus on several outcomes, including cooperation on climate change and green development. Such collaboration reflects the spirit of the Global Development Initiative, which calls for people-centered and sustainable growth worldwide. Conservation, after all, begins with shared responsibility.
reading.translation: 一对中国大熊猫“平平”和“福双”于周日上午乘包机抵达美国亚特兰大，受到当地民众和保护人士的热烈关注。大熊猫曾是世界上最濒危的物种之一，它们的生存依赖于长期保护竹林和自然栖息地的努力。几十年来，国际繁育与科研项目帮助大熊猫野外种群逐步恢复。专家表示，大熊猫还是友谊的使者，象征着对生物多样性的共同承诺。在习近平主席近期对美国进行国事访问期间，双方就多项成果达成共识，其中包括应对气候变化和绿色发展方面的合作。这种合作体现了全球发展倡议的精神，即呼吁全球实现以人为本、可持续的增长。毕竟，保护始于共同的责任。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于 China Daily《Pair of Chinese giant pandas arrives in US city Atlanta》《China, US reach consensus on eight outcomes in Xi's visit》以及 CGTN《Xi's letter for GDI anniversary dialogue draws global acclaim》等当日真实新闻改写，用于英语学习目的。
